body:
> This is interesting! I guess this use-case for "get `StringName` without allocating a `String`" may be a general pattern that is worth investigating.

Yeah, the main purpose of this PR is raise some discussion about this pattern. I'm not quite satisfied with the implementation so I mark it as draft.

> In the case of `Object`, however, I'm not sure this is the right fix. Since `metadata/` is the culprit, it may be better to remove needing a prefix in the first place. I say this with the caveat that I don't know why it was designed like this in the first place, so perhaps somebody can clear this up?

The input of `Object::get()/set()` has this prefix, which seems even more wide-used than `Object::set/get_meta()`, if we remove that we need an extra `substr()` in them. If we decide to change this we need to check carefully to avoid any regressions.
